information:
Sumatra Open 2018 is the 4th competition to be held in Pekanbaru, Riau. 
This competition is capped at **100** competitors.

**IMPORTANT!** In accordance with articles 2g, 2k, and 2l, competitors that fail to abide by the specified WCA regulations shall be disqualified, at the discretion of the WCA delegate.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

For further information, please contact [Mulyono(+6282286250825)](mailto:mulyono1998@gmail.com) via Email or WhatsApp.
